tasks.label: Build SFML
tasks.command: clang++ -std=c++17 src/*.cpp src/maps/*.cpp -o gaeljail -I$(brew --prefix sfml)/include -L$(brew --prefix sfml)/lib -lsfml-graphics -lsfml-window -lsfml-system && ./gaeljail

tasks.label: Run tests
tasks.command: clang++ -std=c++17 tests/KeycardPuzzle_test.cpp src/maps/KeycardPuzzle.cpp -o /tmp/keycard_test && /tmp/keycard_test && clang++ -std=c++17 tests/LockerPuzzle_test.cpp src/maps/LockerPuzzle.cpp -o /tmp/locker_test && /tmp/locker_test && clang++ -std=c++17 tests/CourtPuzzle_test.cpp src/maps/CourtPuzzle.cpp -o /tmp/court_test && /tmp/court_test
